display_name: Options OI Anomaly Directional Pressure Inquiry
expression_text: Detect unusually large same-day option open-interest and volume pressure by contract, expiry, delta bucket, and moneyness; convert call/put imbalance, OI delta, volume/OI expansion, IV shift, and optional gamma*OI into a directional-pressure hypothesis only when the option snapshot is time-aligned to the underlying bar and future outcome window.
paradigm: options flow and open-interest anomaly inquiry
target_market_hypothesis: US listed equity and ETF options with historical or repeated OI snapshots
IBKR option-chain or market-data snapshots when local entitlement supports OI fields
Hubble or other explicit options-chain providers exposing open_interest and volume
browser/yfinance snapshots only as observation inputs until repeated windows and outcome rows exist
regime_role: flow-imbalance sub-regime evidence and candidate directional-pressure overlay; not a trade trigger by itself
evidence_window: requires historical or repeated intraday/end-of-day option OI snapshots joined without lookahead to underlying bars and realized forward outcomes; a single same-day OI snapshot is observation-only

lookahead_guards: do not use end-of-day OI as if it were known during earlier intraday bars
do not score fixed gamma/OI snapshots against older historical outcome rows
do not infer buy/sell aggressor from OI alone; keep direction as hypothesis until quote/trade context exists

factor_signal_definition.long_pressure: call OI delta and volume/OI expansion concentrated near active DTE/delta buckets, confirmed by IV firming and non-stale underlying response
factor_signal_definition.short_pressure: put OI delta and volume/OI expansion concentrated near active DTE/delta buckets, confirmed by IV firming and non-stale underlying response
factor_signal_definition.neutral_or_reject: OI change is stale, broad hedging noise, missing prior OI, wide-spread option prints, or not time-aligned to the outcome bar
